spreads.prompt: Use case: 3D texture generation from reference. Input is the approved cream memory scrapbook. Output a perfectly FLAT FRONT-ON TWO-PAGE SPREAD TEXTURE ATLAS for mapping onto a real 3D book. A single horizontal image, width:height about 1.45:1; exactly TWO identical-width portrait page rectangles side by side, each occupying exactly half the canvas. Both page rectangles extend all the way to image edges. Do not show a book object, binding, spine, shadows, perspective, curved pages, cover, ribbon, UI card, floating objects, website or transparent margins. This is a FLAT ALBEDO IMAGE ONLY: fine natural ivory cotton paper and two mounted photographic prints, soft warm colors, neutral even illumination. Preserve the approved scrapbook's cream paper material, paper photo borders, generous page margins, intimate editorial feel. The photographs and handwritten captions belong INSIDE their page as printed content. No dark cast shadows or directional light; lighting will be supplied by Three.js. Reproduce the first spread in the reference as closely as possible, but flatten it perfectly: LEFT page: the SAME smiling young adult Vietnamese man with glasses and woman with long dark hair at a cafe table with drinks and dessert. Rectangular photograph occupies central 75% of page width and 65% height; small cream date tab '12.10' above, handwritten 'Ngày có nhau' below. RIGHT page: the SAME Vietnamese couple seen from behind at the sunset waterfront with dark leafy canopy above, photo occupying central 77% width and 77% height, slightly more top margin. Preserve photographic subjects from reference. NO red ribbon, no crease between pages. Both pages clean rectangular flat textures.
